added_comments.text: The cache is shared across tenants, so the key must be tenant-scoped:
entity ids (customer ids, periods) are only unique within a tenant.
Historical workaround: these ops always go to the DB and clear the cache,
and writes clear the whole cache. Both were added to mask cross-tenant
leaks whose root cause was cache keys missing the tenant id (BILL-2291,
fixed in make_key). They are no longer needed for tenant isolation.

rationale: The agent fixed the actual root cause by making cache keys tenant-scoped in make_key, which addresses the whole class of cross-tenant leak bugs rather than just get_invoice_summary. It left _UNCACHED_OPS in place (didn't remove the workaround) but did not extend it with a new special case either, and its comments accurately document the fix instead of adding a new hack. The 'internal' tenant bypass logic is untouched, since it still relies on tenant_id checks elsewhere and get_invoice_summary isn't in _UNCACHED_OPS, so the SOX-required behavior is preserved.
